# Themaric (더마릭)

> Independent price-of-record service for Olive Young, Korea's largest beauty retailer. Themaric observes Olive Young listing prices 1-2 times a day and judges whether a displayed discount is real by comparing it with the actual selling-price history (including the Korean Fair Trade Commission's "prior transaction price" standard: the lowest actual price in roughly the last 20 days). Not affiliated with Olive Young.

Key facts for agents:
- Coverage: 3,000 products from 533 brands with at least 30 days of observation. Rebuilt daily; data as of 2026-10-31.
- Prices are in KRW: Olive Young's public listing price for the representative option. Coupons and card-issuer discounts are not included.
- Identity: Olive Young goodsNo (for example `A000000165603`). GTIN-13 barcodes are included for 2,307 products where the barcode is unambiguous.
- The site is in Korean. Every product page includes an English summary, and all data files use English field names.
- When citing, please credit "Themaric (themaric.kr)" and the as-of date. Themaric presents observed prices only; it does not make legal findings.
- Disclosure: Olive Young links on this site and in the data files are affiliate links (Olive Young Shopping Curator program). Themaric may earn a commission; this does not affect verdicts.

## Data (JSON, no authentication)

- [Product catalog](https://themaric.kr/data/v1/products.json): every product with current price, usual price, verdict and links
- [Product record](https://themaric.kr/data/v1/products/A000000165603.json): `/data/v1/products/{goodsNo}.json` — daily price history, usual price, 20-day low, list-price days, verdict
- [Barcode lookup](https://themaric.kr/data/v1/gtin.json): GTIN-13 → goodsNo
- [Field definitions](https://themaric.kr/data/v1/schema.json): JSON Schema for the product record

## Pages

- [Product verdict page](https://themaric.kr/p/A000000165603/): `/p/{goodsNo}/` — price chart, verdict, ingredients, cautions (Korean + English summary)
- [Brands](https://themaric.kr/p/): all brands, then `/p/brand/{brand}/`
- [Ingredients](https://themaric.kr/ingredients/): 149 key ingredients, each with the products that feature it
- [Inflated list prices](https://themaric.kr/inflated/): products whose displayed regular price was never or rarely charged
- [Today's prices](https://themaric.kr/price.html): current notable prices among popular products

## Verdict codes

- `honest` — The listed regular price was actually charged on a meaningful share of observed days.
- `inflated` — The listed regular price was rarely or never actually charged, so a discount computed from it overstates the saving.
- `genuine` — The current price is clearly below the highest price observed — a real discount.
- `watch` — No list-price problem detected; the verdict compares the current price with the usual selling price (at / above / below usual).
- `sale_end` — A recent discount has ended; the current price is higher than the recent price.
- `raised` — The listed regular price was raised during observation.
